details: The European Central Bank (ECB) increased its key interest rates by 25 basis points to 2.50% on September 10, 2026, citing resilient domestic demand and revised higher inflation projections for the Eurozone. The ECB also upgraded its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 0.9%. This monetary tightening, against a backdrop of persistent high inflation and energy price pressures exacerbated by the Middle East conflict, is noted to impact liquidity and crypto markets, which remain under tightening regulatory focus.
title: ECB Raises Rates, Lifts Eurozone Growth Forecast

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) projects global economic output to grow by approximately 3% in 2026, indicating resilience despite the ongoing Middle East conflict and elevated energy prices. However, the IMF warned that risks remain high due to increasing global public debt, stalled disinflation, and the contrasting forces of energy supply shocks and an AI-led technology boom.
title: IMF Forecasts 3% Global Growth in 2026 Amid High Risks

details: The U.S. consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.4% in August, bringing the annual inflation rate to 3.4%, in line with expectations. However, core CPI, excluding volatile food and energy prices, increased a slightly higher-than-forecast 0.3% for the month. These figures, coupled with a 5.4% year-over-year rise in the Producer Price Index (PPI), have significantly increased market expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next week, with odds now at roughly 85%.
title: US Inflation Accelerates in August, Strengthening Fed Hike Bets

details: Bitcoin's price slid below $77,000, touching a low of $76,555, following the ECB's interest rate hike and the release of hotter-than-expected U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) data. This downward movement was compounded by renewed institutional outflows from U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, marking the second consecutive day of redemptions and indicating profit-taking and a market repricing amidst fears of tighter monetary policy.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $77,000 as Macro Pressures Mount

details: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that new sanctions will be imposed next Monday against a significant bank suspected of channeling $1.8 billion in financing to Iran. This initiative is part of broader U.S. efforts to isolate Iran from global financial networks amidst the ongoing Middle East conflict.
title: US Plans Sanctions on Major Bank for Iran War Financing

details: The sector for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) experienced a positive surge, notably with SpaceX Tokenised bStocks (SPCXB) rising by 3.3%. This boost in sentiment followed Nasdaq's recent $100 million investment in Payward, the parent company of Kraken, on September 10, 2026. The investment aims to advance Nasdaq Equity Tokens (NETs), signaling a growing institutional commitment to on-chain stocks.
title: Nasdaq Investment Fuels Tokenized Equity Market Momentum

details: The "Clarity Act," a significant piece of legislation aimed at establishing a market structure for digital assets, is scheduled for a cloture vote in the Senate next week. Despite congressional procedural challenges and a condensed September session, bipartisan efforts continue to formulate clear regulatory guidelines for the digital asset industry. An updated draft of the bill incorporates over 100 changes requested by Democrats, including provisions for DeFi protocol registration with the CFTC.
title: Clarity Act Nears Senate Vote Amidst Push for Crypto Regulation
